en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large half-timbered building labeled 'Hotel Kurhaus' nestled among dense trees, with hills and a distinctive wooden structure (saline graduation tower) in the background. The text on the top in German reads 'Bad Sulza. Hotel-Kurhaus m. Gradierwerken.' The setting is rural and scenic, with the architecture characteristic of German spa towns.
